comment_text.value: One immediate advantage that rescheduling-capable cores have that rigid compiler-based ones don’t nor ever would is that reschedules can notice patterns in execution in the current context and keep the ALU fed from well-provisioned caches even going as far as speculative execution. IA-64 and typeless or typed-at-runtime (JIT scripts, for example, like JavaScript or Python) would’ve been implemented very differently on Itanium.

story_title.value: A new Intel Itanium (IA-64) emulator that boots Windows
